games.en_summary: A fantasy auto-battler where you place a squad and then watch it fight the battle on its own.
games.title: Knightica
games.zh_summary: 带兵布阵的幻想自走棋，先排好队伍，再看它们自己打完一仗。

games.en_summary: A survival-horror game about hiding from a single alien aboard a space station, with almost no fair fight.
games.title: Alien: Isolation
games.zh_summary: 在太空站里躲着一只异形求生，大多数时候只能藏，不能硬拼。

games.en_summary: A pirate action-adventure that fights its way through shipwrecks and sea monsters.
games.title: Mark of the Deep
games.zh_summary: 海盗题材的动作冒险，在沉船与海怪之间一路打过去。

games.en_summary: A rally racing game that runs full stages over dirt, gravel and snow.
games.title: WRC Generations
games.zh_summary: 拉力赛车游戏，在泥路和雪地里按赛段跑完全程。

games.en_summary: A silly sandbox game about a squirrel with a gun causing trouble around a small town.
games.title: Squirrel with a Gun
games.zh_summary: 一只拿着枪的松鼠在小镇里闹事，荒诞又好笑的沙盒小品。

games.en_summary: A park-management game where you build a dinosaur park, keep the animals fed, and keep the fences holding.
games.title: Jurassic World Evolution 2
games.zh_summary: 建一座恐龙公园，养龙、修围栏，还要防着它们跑出来。

games.en_summary: A post-apocalyptic game about answering distress calls on a radio station, where each choice decides a stranger's fate.
games.title: Radiolight
games.zh_summary: 在末世电台里接听求助电话，靠选择决定别人的生死。

games.en_summary: An action game where you play a werewolf, switching between human and wolf form to fight.
games.title: Werewolf: The Apocalypse - Earthblood
games.zh_summary: 扮演狼人，在人类形态和狼形态之间切换着打。

games.en_summary: A dark fairy-tale puzzle adventure that follows a small insect trying to find its way home.
games.title: Clem
games.zh_summary: 黑暗童话风的解谜冒险，跟着一只小虫子找回回家的路。

games.en_summary: A visual-novel role-playing game where the story and your choices matter more than combat.
games.title: Arcadia Fallen
games.zh_summary: 视觉小说式的角色扮演，故事和选择比战斗更重要。

games.en_summary: A vampire narrative role-playing game with three intertwined stories, driven by dialogue and choices.
games.title: Vampire: The Masquerade - Swansong
games.zh_summary: 吸血鬼题材的叙事角色扮演，三条线交错，靠对话和选择推进。

games.en_summary: A World War I psychological horror game that moves back and forth between nightmares and reality.
games.title: Ad Infinitum
games.zh_summary: 一战背景的心理恐怖游戏，在噩梦和现实之间来回走。

games.en_summary: A cyberpunk prison action roguelite where each death means a new build and another run.
games.title: Kiborg
games.zh_summary: 赛博朋克监狱里的动作肉鸽，每次死后换一套打法再来。

games.en_summary: A cozy shop game about cleaning up odd trinkets, upcycling them, and selling them on.
games.title: Trash Goblin
games.zh_summary: 温馨小店经营：收拾各种古怪小玩意儿，翻新改造后再卖出去。

games.en_summary: Escape-room puzzles and hidden objects built around a broken time machine.
games.title: Time Travel: Escape Room Game
games.zh_summary: 围绕一台坏掉的时间机器解谜、找隐藏物品的密室逃脱。

games.en_summary: A laid-back road trip in a van across a sci-fi world inspired by Provence.
games.title: Caravan SandWitch
games.zh_summary: 开着房车在普罗旺斯风情的科幻世界里悠闲探索。

games.en_summary: A sci-fi real-time strategy game where four clans fight over a fallen empire.
games.title: WarBreeds
games.zh_summary: 科幻即时战略，四个氏族为一个陨落的帝国开战。

note: All summaries are written in our own words. No store description text is copied. Claim-by dates verified 2026-11-17 from Epic and Prime/Luna listings via independent trackers; the four October-batch Prime games (Trash Goblin, Time Travel: Escape Room Game, Caravan SandWitch, WarBreeds) were added 2026-11-17 after their deadlines were read on the Luna claims detail pages and cross-checked on trackers; TBC means Amazon had not published an end date when checked.
